Definition: a Maakathite, or inhabitant of Maakah
BiblicalUsage: Maachathite = "pressure (literally she has pressed)"; 1) used of one of David's mighty warriors; 2) used of an associate of Ishmael coll; 3) a people dwelling in Transjordan, probably descendants of Maachah
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
